en:
Thinking about the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Hunt<CLT=cltNORMAL>
is a pain...

Why don't we get all our memories back 
at once...? Monokuma's kind of a jerk...
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Himiko for a while?

If you're gonna stay here, then you could
at least make me a cup of tea...

<CLT=cltMIND>Himiko and I spent some time
preparing and drinking tea together...
<CLT=cltMIND>Himiko and I grew a little closer today.
